question: Evaluate: 30 - [30 - {30 - (30 - 30 × 4)}]
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: 30 - [30 - {30 - (30 - 30 × 4)}]

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

**Calculations:**
